description: What became of a draft you made with draft_poll: waiting (not opened), opened (opened by your person, not saved), saved (it is a poll now) or expired. Send the mp_draft_ token from the draft's link in the body; it is never sent in a URL. Once saved it says when and, only if the poll's owner made it public, its public page, and nothing else about the poll or its owner, nor whether it has run. Use it to follow up instead of asking your person. (POST /api/v1/drafts/status)

token.description: The mp_draft_ token: the value of draft= in the draft's link.

name: draft_status
title: What became of a draft
